# ActivityEnergyTradeoff

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The relationship between the number of spikes (activity) in a spiking network and the energy consumed, where reducing spikes generally lowers energy but may degrade accuracy. Central to optimizing iNEST neuromorphic accelerators, as it determines the achievable energy gains from sparsity-aware routing and computation.
